scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Welcome to the
Alchemist Unio--
I-Impossible! How c-can
something like this happen?
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
欢迎来到炼金术士工会——
不、不可能！
怎、怎么会有这种事？

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Welcome, {0}.
The Alchemist Union
is busy today, like always.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
欢迎，{0}。
炼金术士工会今天也和往常一样忙碌。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Welcome to the
Alchemist Union.
We are recruiting
talented people
with novel ideas.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
欢迎来到炼金术士工会。
我们正在招募才华出众、富有新意的人。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Welcome to the
Alchemist Union.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
欢迎来到炼金术士工会。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Well now~!
You've brought an
Old Magic Book and
a Hammer of Blacksmith.
We'll put these items
to good use.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
哎呀~！
您带来了古魔法书和高级铁砧。
我们会好好利用这些物品的。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Seems like
you're all ready.
The Union will put
these items to good use.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
看来您已经准备好了。
工会会好好利用这些物品的。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Aren't you ready?
Like I said before,
you must bring
^551A8B{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
您还没准备好吗？
我之前说过，您必须带来^551A8B{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Go and talk to
Mr. Raspuchin.
He's involved in the
Alchemist selection process, whatever that might mean.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
去找拉斯普钦先生谈谈吧。
他参与炼金术士的选拔工作，至于具体做什么，我也不太清楚。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Ah, I'm sorry, but
I'm busy right now~
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
啊，抱歉，我现在正忙着呢~

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Wait, wait...
I'm sorry. I was confused,
that's all. You look just like
someone I used to know. 
Still, I get this weird
feeling about you...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
等等，等等...
抱歉，刚才是我认错人了。
您长得很像我以前认识的一个人。
不过，您还是给我一种奇怪的感觉...

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Everyone is busy with their
own research, but recently, some headway has been made in the field of biotechnology.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
大家都在忙各自的研究，不过最近生物技术领域取得了一些进展。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Everyone is hoping that the biotechnological studies will yield positive results. Speaking of which, I wonder how the Alchemists working on artificial life are doing...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
大家都希望生物技术研究能取得成果。
说起来，不知道那些研究人造生命的炼金术士进展如何了...

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
If you're interested in working with chemistry, visit us later when you become more knowledgable.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果您对化学研究感兴趣，等学识更丰富些再来找我们吧。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Just one thing:
You've got to have
knowledge of items
as a Merchant first.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
有一点要记住：您得先以商人的身份掌握物品知识。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
If you know any exceptional Merchants, by all means, please refer them to us. Those types of people tend to have a talent for Alchemy and experimentation~
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果您认识出色的商人，请务必推荐给我们。
这类人往往很有炼金术和实验方面的天赋~

scripts.text: I would like to learn about Alchemists.
scripts.translation: 我想了解炼金术士

scripts.text: I want to become an Alchemist.
scripts.translation: 我想成为炼金术士

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Alchemists study and create new substances and items out of existing materials. Our knowledge allows us to change the properties of chemicals at the atomic level.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
炼金术士研究如何用现有材料创造新的物质和物品。
凭借这些知识，我们能在原子层面改变化学物质的性质。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Most people think our final goal
is to create gold, but that's not the entire truth. We also want to create things like medicines
and new materials.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
大多数人以为我们的最终目标是制造黄金，其实并不尽然。
我们也希望研制药物和新材料。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
A few of us research the
creation of life, although many of us consider that god's territory. That field is so complex, most of us deal with slightly less complicated projects anyway.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
我们当中有少数人在研究如何创造生命，不过很多人认为那是神的领域。
这个领域太复杂了，所以大多数人还是选择研究稍微简单些的课题。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
If you are interested in becoming an Alchemist, I recommend that you first get a lot of experience as a Merchant. Being a Merchant is a great opportunity to learn about materials as you deal with them.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果您想成为炼金术士，我建议先多积累些商人的经验。
商人经常接触各种材料，是了解材料的好机会。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Whether or not you try to become
an Alchemist is your decision. The road to becoming an Alchemist is very challenging, and you'll need to focus on experimentation and research, instead of commerce.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
要不要成为炼金术士，由您自己决定。
这条路充满挑战，您得把重心从经商转向实验和研究。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Is that so?
Nice to meet you.
My name is Parmy Gianino
of the Alchemist Union.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
是吗？
很高兴认识您。
我是炼金术士工会的帕米·吉亚尼诺。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
If you join our Union and
complete the training, you
will be officially recognized
as an Alchemist and be able
to contribute to our research.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
加入我们的工会并完成训练后，您就会被正式认可为炼金术士，也能为我们的研究贡献力量。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
But we don't accept everyone.
You must have a lot of tenacity
and sincere devotion in exploring
the various fields of science.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
不过，我们可不是来者不拒。
您必须有坚韧的毅力，并真心投入对各个科学领域的探索。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
There are a couple
of requirements to join
the Alchemist Union, but
we'll discuss that
after you apply.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
加入炼金术士工会需要满足一些条件，不过等您报名后，我们再详细谈。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Well then, would
you like to apply
for registration?
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
那么，您想报名吗？

scripts.text: I would like to apply.
scripts.translation: 我想报名

scripts.text: I'll do it later.
scripts.translation: 以后再来

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Hmmm...
Just a moment.
I'm sorry to say that
you're not experienced
enough as a Merchant to
join us right now.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
嗯...
请稍等。
很遗憾，您作为商人的经验还不够，目前还不能加入我们。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
You must be at least
^551A8BJob Level 40^000000 to become
an Alchemist. Come back
later when you meet the
Job Level requirement, okay?
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
您必须达到^551A8B职业等级40^000000才能成为炼金术士。
等达到要求再来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Alright, your application has been accepted. Now, you must pay the 50,000 Zeny application fee and bring some items before you can begin your formal training.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
好的，您的申请已受理。
接下来需要缴纳50,000 Zeny报名费，并带来一些物品，才能开始正式训练。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
But if you bring an ^551A8BOld Magic Book^000000 and ^551A8BHammer of Blacksmith^000000,
we will accept that as a substitute for the item requirement.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
不过，如果您带来^551A8B古魔法书^000000和^551A8B高级铁砧^000000，就可以代替原本要求的物品。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Now...
Please sign
the application.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
现在...
请在申请表上签字。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Good, good. Now, if you have
the Zeny for your application fee ready, I will tell you which items you will need to bring. Now, pay attention.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
很好，很好。
如果您已经备好报名费，我就告诉您需要带哪些物品。
请听仔细。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Uh oh. You don't
seem to have enough Zeny.
Come back to me when you have 50,000 Zeny, otherwise we can't process your application.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
哎呀，您的 Zeny 好像不够。
请备齐50,000 Zeny再来，否则我们无法办理您的申请。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
让我看看。
{0}需要带来...

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
^551A8B7 Berserk Potions^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
让我看看。
{0}需要带来...^551A8B7瓶菠色克药水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
^551A8B100 Mini Furnaces^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
让我看看。
{0}需要带来...^551A8B100个携带用熔矿炉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
^551A8B7,500 Fire Arrows^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
让我看看。
{0}需要带来...^551A8B7,500支火箭矢^000000。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Once you've gathered
those items, come back
to me and your training
as an Alchemist will begin.
See you soon~
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
收集齐这些物品后，请回来找我，就可以开始炼金术士的训练了。
回头见~

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Talented Merchants
are always welcome here.
Please come back soon.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
我们随时欢迎有才华的商人。
希望您早日回来。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Umm...
Please let me know
if you need anything.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
嗯...
有什么需要，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Okay, now you need to learn
the basics to being an Alchemist and learn the procedures for mixing chemicals and medicines.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
接下来，您需要学习炼金术士的基础知识，以及调配化学药品和药剂的方法。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
But before all of that, you need to speak to Raspuchin. I'm not really sure what you'll be talking about with him...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
不过在那之前，您得先去找拉斯普钦谈谈。
我也不太清楚你们会聊些什么...

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
It shouldn't be anything extraordinary, but you're still required to speak to Raspuchin, since apparently he's a part of the Alchemist selection process.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
应该不是什么特别的事，不过您还是得去找拉斯普钦。
听说他也参与炼金术士的选拔。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Okay, now you need to learn
the basics to being an Alchemist and learn the procedures for mixing chemicals and medicines.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
接下来，您需要学习炼金术士的基础知识，以及调配化学药品和药剂的方法。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
But before all of that, you need to speak to Raspuchin. I'm not really sure what you'll be talking about with him...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
不过在那之前，您得先去找拉斯普钦谈谈。
我也不太清楚你们会聊些什么...

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
It shouldn't be anything extraordinary, but you're still required to speak to Raspuchin, since apparently he's a part of the Alchemist selection process.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
应该不是什么特别的事，不过您还是得去找拉斯普钦。
听说他也参与炼金术士的选拔。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Come back when you
have prepared the
required items.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
准备好所需物品后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Hopefully, it
won't be too much of
a problem. I guess he'll just interview you, and ask you
some simple questions.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
希望不会太麻烦。
我想他只是给您面试，问几个简单的问题。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Why don't you ask
someone else if you're
not sure who to visit
next? Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果不清楚接下来该找谁，就问问其他人吧？
祝您好运~

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
Eh? What do you want?!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
嗯？你想干什么？！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
How cute, you've come
all this way just to play...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
真可爱，跑这么远就是为了来玩...

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What is it?!
You're curious as
to what I'm doing?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
怎么了？！
你想知道我在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
What do you
want, kid?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
小鬼，你想干什么？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What...?!
You want to take
the test again?!
I thought I told
you to leave!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
什么...？！
你还想再考一次？！
我不是叫你走了吗！

scripts.text: [Raspuchin Gregory]
scripts.translation: [拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What are you doing?
Go and find Darwin now.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你还在干什么？
快去找达尔文。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Keheheheheheheheh~
Don't think this is the end of it!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Keheheheheheheheh~
别以为这就结束了！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You're not here to steal my experimental results or plagiarize my work, are you? How dare you consider intellectual theft!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你该不会是来偷我的实验成果，或是抄袭我的研究吧？
竟敢打窃取知识成果的主意！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You're not, are you?
Well, as a colleague,
let me just warn you
that such tricks aren't
tolerated here in the
Alchemist Union!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你没这个打算吧？
好，作为同行，我得警告你：炼金术士工会绝不容忍这种勾当！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
I'll let you
go this time...
But next time, don't
expect to leave so easily...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
这次就放过你...
下次可别想这么轻易就走...

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heehee
keheheh~!
Why, I'm busy
researching,
of course!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Heehee
keheheh~!
我当然是在忙着做研究！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Once this
potion is complete...
You can use it to take
over an entire nation!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
等这种药水研制成功...
就能用它征服整个国家！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Hee hee hee!
Something this
dangerous has to
be kept a secret!
Understand?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Hee hee hee!
这么危险的东西，必须保密！
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
A Merchant should go and set up shop and vend items. Why are you wandering in a place like this?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
商人就该去摆摊卖东西。
你在这种地方瞎逛什么？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heheheh~!
Go vend somwhere else!
And leave me to my
dark enterprise!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Heheheh~!
到别处摆摊去！
别妨碍我的黑暗事业！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What...?
Learn Alchemy?!
Don't even speak
such nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
什么...？
学炼金术？！
别胡说八道了！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Even if you tried studying for a thousand years, maybe even more, it'd be useless to you! Forget about it and just worry about your store!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
就算你学上一千年，甚至更久，也是白费力气！
别想了，好好顾你的店吧！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What...?
Join the Union!?
I don't like it...
I just don't...!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
什么...？
加入工会？！
我不喜欢...
就是不喜欢...！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Nowadays, anyone thinks they can
be Alchemists just by knowing how to mix a few herbs. That's why my interview is necessary.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
现在的人，会混合几株草药，就以为自己能当炼金术士了。
所以才需要我来面试！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
I plan on weeding out all the dumb and incompetent, and chase them
all away! We don't need morons!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
我要把那些愚蠢无能的家伙统统筛掉，赶出去！
我们不需要笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Wait...
Maybe I've
misjudged you.
You might be a pretty boy,
but I can tell you're smart
from your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
等等...
也许我看走眼了。
你虽然长得挺俊，但看你的眼神，我知道你脑子也不差。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Wait...
Maybe I've
misjudged you.
Huh. You're a cutie alright,
but I can tell you've got brains.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
等等...
也许我看走眼了。
嗯，你确实挺可爱，不过我看得出你也有头脑。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You're not just some stupid kid.
I can tell youve gone through some rough times as a Merchant. Excellent. Keh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你可不是什么傻小鬼。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Ooh...
Excellent! Great!
You got them all correct!?
Keheheh, I have no choice but to acknowledge you...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Ooh...
太棒了！真厉害！
你竟然全答对了？！
Keheheh，我也只好认可你了...

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You got one wrong!
But I'll let it slide.
You pass the interview!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你答错了一道题！
不过这次就不计较了。
面试通过！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You've got serious
weaknesses in math,
but I'll let you go this time...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你的数学实在太差了，不过这次就放过你...

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh! Idiot!
Just listening to your
answers is making me feel
stupider! You might as well
have got them all wrong!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Keheheh! 笨蛋！
光听你的答案，我都觉得自己变笨了！
跟全答错也差不了多少！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
How can a person that
can't even answer all of
these simple questions think
of becoming an Alchemist?!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
连这些简单的题都答不对，居然还想当炼金术士？！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Hm...?
Did you get
any right?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嗯...？
你有哪道题答对了吗？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Fool! Even if you make one little mistake, everything goes wrong
in Alchemy! Now get out of here!

scripts.translation:

蠢货！
炼金术哪怕出一点小错，也会全盘失败！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

Keheheheheheheheh~
别以为这就结束了！

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Ah...
You...
You've become
an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊...
你...
你已经成为炼金术士了。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
When you have
your dreams, you
have everything.
Without them, you have
nothing more to lose.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
有梦想，就拥有一切。
没有梦想，也就没什么可失去的了。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
...

[Darwin]
I said to go
to Van Helmont.
I'd like to teach you
more, but I can't.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我说过，去找范·赫尔蒙特。
我也想再多教你一些，可是已经教不了什么了。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I have already given you all of my knowledge and have nothing more
to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我已经把所知的一切都传授给你了，没什么能再教你的了。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Remember...
In your quest
to make your
dreams come true,
do not lose what
you cherish.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
记住...
追逐梦想时，别失去自己珍视的东西。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Ah...
Harmona...
My love...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊...
哈莫娜...
我的爱人...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
These cursed eyes...
They've lost sight of
my dreams a long time ago.
Ha ha ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
这双该死的眼睛...
早就看不见我的梦想了。
Ha ha ha ha...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Does paradise
really exist...?
Not without my love...
Not without Harmona...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
天堂真的存在吗...？
没有我的爱人，就没有天堂...
没有哈莫娜，就没有天堂...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
...
......
Who is it...?

[Darwin]
A wolf?
Or a human?
You must be seeking
something, are you not?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
是狼？
还是人？
你一定在寻求什么，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
After all...
Everyone has desires
to fulfill. Be be careful.
Do not be like the wild
wolf drawn to the flowers.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
毕竟...
每个人都有想要满足的欲望。
不过要小心。
别像那被花朵吸引的野狼一样。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
In your efforts to gain something else, you may end up sacrificing something precious to you.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
为了得到某样东西，你可能会牺牲自己珍视的一切。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Cultivating joy and happiness
is much like cultivating flowers.
If something is missing, the
flower will wilt away...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
培育喜悦和幸福，就像养花一样。
少了什么，花就会枯萎...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
What brings you
to this kind of place?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你为什么会来这种地方？

scripts.text: I want to learn how to experiment.
scripts.translation: 我想学习如何做实验

scripts.text: Tell me more about flowers.
scripts.translation: 再讲讲花的事

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
You wish to
learn Alchemy?
Everything I know,
I've learned for the
sake of making my
dream come true...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你想学炼金术？
我学会的一切，都是为了实现自己的梦想...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I'll teach
you the basics...
But everything you
learn afterwards must
be directed through
your own motivations.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我会教你基础知识...
不过，之后要学什么，得由你自己的志向来决定。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I will teach you
how to make simple
medicine. So please
bring the following
materials right away.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我会教你制作简单的药剂。
请尽快准备以下材料。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
^551A8B3 Medicine Bowls^000000,
^551A8B3 Empty Bottles^000000,
^551A8B1 Red Herb^000000,
^551A8B1 Yellow Herb^000000 and
^551A8B1 White Herb^000000.

[Darwin]
Once you have
prepared everything,
return to me.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
东西都准备齐了，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Flowers...?
In the darkest
recesses of my mind,
there is a blossum
that I faintly remember...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
花...？
在记忆最幽暗的角落，有一朵花，我还依稀记得...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
For the one that
I love, I put all
of my efforts into
researching that one thing.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
为了我爱的人，我把所有心血都投入了那项研究。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I won't tell you the details,
but I was basically researching
the relationship between
wolves and flowers.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
细节就不说了。
简单来说，我研究的是狼与花之间的关系。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
But yes...
It was a flower.
With its shine, it was said
to let you see paradise.
The ^551A8BIllusion Flower^000000...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
是的...
那是一朵花。
据说它的光芒能让人看见天堂。
^551A8B幻想花^000000...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I even made
a Homunculus,
but no one believed that I could create new life from a flower...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我甚至创造出了生命体，可是没人相信我能从一朵花中创造新的生命...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Then...
Well, some other things happened, and now I have nothing left. Time no longer has any meaning for me.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
后来...
又发生了一些事，如今我已经一无所有。
时间对我来说，也没了意义。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Ahh...
Harmona...
Where have you gone?
I hope you're in a field
of beautiful flowers...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
Ahh...
哈莫娜...
你去了哪里？
希望你正置身于一片美丽的花海...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Consider what
is most precious
to you. It cannot
be protected if you
do not recognize it.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
想想，什么对你最珍贵。
只有认清这一点，才能守护好它。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
...
......
Who is it...?

[Darwin]
Ah...
You are the one who
wishes to learn Alchemy.
Have you prepared everything?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊...
你就是那个想学炼金术的人。
东西都准备齐了吗？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Wait.
That Illusion Flower.
How did you get that?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
等等。
那朵幻想花，你是怎么得到的？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Where did you find it?!
The flower that slowly
blooms under the
moonlight?
It's beautiful...!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你在哪里找到的？！
那朵在月光下缓缓绽放的花？
真美...！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Th-That flower...
Please let me see it.
The Illusion Flower!
Uwaaaaaaah!!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
那、那朵花...
请让我看看。
幻想花！
Uwaaaaaaah!!

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Would you be so kind
as to let me have this flower?
I'm sure that this is the Moonlight Flower that I've been seeking!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
能请你把这朵花给我吗？
这一定就是我一直在寻找的月光之花！

scripts.text: Sorry, I can't give it to you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，不能给你

scripts.text: I brought it to give to you.
scripts.translation: 我就是带来送给你的

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I understand.
You can't give
such a precious
flower to just anyone.
Well... It's okay.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我明白。
这么珍贵的花，不能随便送人。
嗯...没关系。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
It just brought back old memories. I shouldn't have asked in the first place. In any case, please bring what is needed for the experiment.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
它只是勾起了往事。
我本来就不该开口要的。
总之，请带来实验所需的物品。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Please leave that flower
somewhere else. It brings
back too many memories...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
请把那朵花放到别处去。
它勾起了太多回忆...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Are you
serious?!
Thank you!
Such a precious flower.
Ah, Harmona, my love...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你说真的？！
谢谢你！
这么珍贵的花...
啊，哈莫娜，我的爱人...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Yes...
I shall repay you for this.
I shall plant all of my knowledge of Alchemy directly into your mind...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
是的...
我会报答你的。
我会把自己所有的炼金术知识，直接植入你的脑海...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Open your eyes wide,
and look into my eyes!!
Don't stop until the end!!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
睁大眼睛，直视我的双眼！！
直到结束都不要移开目光！！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
^666666*Gasp...*^000000
You are now
an Alchemist!!
Go to the Union
and cast away the last
vestiges of Merchant life!!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
^666666*Gasp...*^000000
你现在已经是炼金术士了！！
去工会，彻底告别商人的身份吧！！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Seems like you have everything ready. As promised, I will teach you how to make simple medicine.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
看来东西都准备齐了。
按之前说好的，我来教你制作简单的药剂。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
First, prepare the Medicine Bowl. Then, you put the Herbs inside, like this, and slowly crush them.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
首先，准备好药钵。
然后像这样，把药草放进去，慢慢研碎。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Pour small amounts
of clean water and stir
the mixture until it thickens.
Afterwards, add some more Herbs.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
倒入少量清水，搅拌至浓稠。
然后再加入一些药草。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
That's how you make it. If you think you have enough, gently pour the mixture into an empty bottle.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
制作方法就是这样。
觉得分量足够了，就小心地把混合物倒入空瓶。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
There you go,
it's complete.
Now, make some medicine
using the simple procedure
I just explained to you.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
好了，完成了。
现在按照我刚才讲的简单步骤，试着制作药剂吧。

scripts.text: Prepare the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 准备药钵

scripts.text: Put the Medicine Bowl on your head.
scripts.translation: 把药钵顶在头上

scripts.text: Kick the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 踢药钵

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
What...?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
什么...？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
No!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
不！

scripts.text: Put some dirt in the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 在药钵里放些泥土

scripts.text: Put some Herbs in the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 在药钵里放入药草

scripts.text: Put a Harp in the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 在药钵里放把竖琴

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
...Eh!?
That's not
medicine!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
...嗯？！
这可不是药剂！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
A Harp?
And how would
you do that?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
竖琴？
你打算怎么把它放进去？

scripts.text: Crush the Herbs.
scripts.translation: 捣碎药草

scripts.text: Crush the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 砸碎药钵

scripts.text: Crush Darwin's foot.
scripts.translation: 踩达尔文的脚

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Wh-What are
you doing!?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你、你在干什么？！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Agh...!
What do you
think you're
doing?!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
Agh...!
你究竟在干什么？！

scripts.text: Spray clean water.
scripts.translation: 喷洒清水

scripts.text: Drink clean water.
scripts.translation: 喝清水

scripts.text: Pour clean water.
scripts.translation: 倒入清水

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Huh?
What are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
诶？
你在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
W-wait...
Are you
taking a break?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
等、等一下...
你是在休息吗？

scripts.text: Continue crushing the Herbs.
scripts.translation: 继续捣碎药草

scripts.text: Continue eating the Herbs.
scripts.translation: 继续吃药草

scripts.text: Continue dancing and singing.
scripts.translation: 继续唱歌跳舞

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Eat the Herbs?
I think you need
to focus on the
task at hand...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
吃药草？
我看你该专心做眼前的事...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Singing and
dancing? Alchemists
don't do that, have
you gone crazy?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
唱歌跳舞？
炼金术士可不是做这个的，你疯了吗？

scripts.text: Put noodles in and fry it.
scripts.translation: 放入面条炒一炒

scripts.text: Pour it in an empty bottle.
scripts.translation: 倒入空瓶中

scripts.text: Hold the Medicine Bowl and drink it.
scripts.translation: 端起药钵喝掉

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
We're Alchemists,
not restaurant chefs.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我们是炼金术士，不是餐厅厨师。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Huh...
Pretty sloppy...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
嗯...
真够马虎的...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
You messed up the mixture
since you didn't follow the procedure! Get some more ingredients so you can try it
again until you get it right.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你没按步骤操作，把药剂弄坏了！
再去准备些材料，重新试一遍，直到做对为止。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Good job.
It came out pretty well considering it's your first time. Go ahead and keep the medicines that you've just made.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
做得好。
第一次就能做到这样，已经很不错了。
刚才做好的药剂就留给你吧。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Now, go into the next room
and speak to Van Helmont to
continue your training.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
现在去隔壁房间找范·赫尔蒙特，继续训练。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Never forget...
You must always protect
what is most precious to you.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
千万别忘了...
一定要守护好自己最珍视的东西。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Have you forgotten
what you need to bring?
Let me remind you once
again. You must come
back with...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
忘记要带什么了吗？
我再提醒你一次。
你需要带来...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
^551A8B3 Medicine Bowls^000000,
^551A8B3 Empty Bottle^000000,
^551A8B1 Red Herb^000000,
^551A8B1 Yellow Herb^000000 and
^551A8B1 White Herb^000000.

[Darwin]
Come back
when you are
ready...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
准备好再来...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Aah...
Harmona, my love.
I can't even see the flower anymore. My soul quietly
withers as well..
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
Aah...
哈莫娜，我的爱人。
我连那朵花都看不见了。
我的灵魂也在悄然枯萎...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Go to the second floor and talk to speak to our Union Leader. Once
you do that, your life as an Alchemist will begin.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
去二楼找我们的会长谈谈。
之后，你作为炼金术士的生活就要开始了。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
These cursed eyes...
They've lost sight of
my dreams a long time ago.
Ha ha ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
这双该死的眼睛...
早就看不见我的梦想了。
Ha ha ha ha...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Does paradise
really exist...?
Not without my love...
Not without Harmona...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
天堂真的存在吗...？
没有我的爱人，就没有天堂...
没有哈莫娜，就没有天堂...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What do you want?
I'm busy!! Don't
bother me and get
on your way.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你想干什么？
我很忙！！
别来烦我，走开。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Just a little...
A little bit more...
Nooo! Just a little
bit more and it
would've been done!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
就差一点...
再多一点点...
Nooo! 再差一点点就完成了！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Arrrrgh...!
Why isn't this formula working? What's wrong? In theory, it's all correct, but there must be an error in the formula somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
Arrrrgh...!
这配方为什么不管用？
哪里出错了？
理论上都没问题，可配方里一定有哪里错了...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Alright, if I make an incision here in the Tentacle, and add a Jellopy and Sticky Mucus solution into the... Where the hell did my Medicine Bowl go?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好，在触手这里切个口，再把杰勒比结晶和粘稠液体配成的溶液加到...
我的药钵到底跑哪去了？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What...?
I thought I told you to
talk to Nicholas next door?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
什么...？
我不是叫你去找隔壁的尼古拉了吗？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Now, come on...
You'll never get
any research completed if you just slack off. Go out and learn all that you can.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好了，快去吧...
光偷懒可完成不了研究。
出去尽可能多学点东西。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Reading science journals and performing experiments. That's what Alchemy is all about. Now, let me get back to work!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
阅读科学期刊，动手做实验，这就是炼金术。
好了，让我继续工作！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Why...?!
Why, another failure?!
My calculations were
all correct! W-Wait...!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
为什么...？！
怎么又失败了？！
我的计算明明都没错！
等、等等...！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Perhaps, if I capacitated the thermal flux by using the neutronic gradient, it just might work...!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
也许利用中子梯度来增强热流，就能成功...！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
I pour it in here, and it should stop. Wait, this is the wrong solution! How could I make such
a dumb mistake?! When did these
get switched?!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
倒进这里，应该就能停下了。
等等，拿错溶液了！
我怎么会犯这么蠢的错误？！
它们什么时候被调换的？！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Okay, okay...
I just need to fix this part.
No need to start over. I just
need to fix it... But wait. Wait...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好，好...
只要把这部分修正就行。
不必重来。
修正一下就好...
可是等等。
等等...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Um...
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
嗯...
你是谁？

scripts.text: I want to become an Alchemist.
scripts.translation: 我想成为炼金术士

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Hmm...?
What, did you just want to watch? Fine, fine, but do it quietly and leave right when you're done.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
嗯...？
怎么，只是想看看？
好，好，不过要安静，看完就走。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Stay out of my way and don't go around touching stuff. There might be some volatile materials, so it'd be dangerous to have any accidents.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
别挡路，也别乱碰东西。
这里可能有些不稳定的材料，万一出事故会很危险。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
You...?
An Alchemist?
What a funny Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你...？
想当炼金术士？
真是个有趣的商人。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Well, that's nice, but I have very urgent experiments that require
my attention, so don't get
in the way.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
嗯，挺好，不过我有紧急的实验要做，别来妨碍我。

scripts.text: Teach me something.
scripts.translation: 教我点东西

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Argh...!
Didn't I just tell you not to bother me? What's so hard to understand about that?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
Argh...!
我不是刚说了别烦我吗？
这话就那么难懂？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Fine, fine. I'll give you an assignment. Learn something
new and come back. Let's see.
What would be good...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好，好。
给你个任务，去学点新东西再来。
让我想想。
学什么好呢...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Okay, I got it.
Go learn how to make
a Counteragent and Mixture
from Molgenstein.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好，想到了。
去找莫尔根斯坦，学习制作中和剂和混合剂。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
You don't need to bring anything. Just go watch him at work and have him tell you how he makes those solutions. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
不用带任何东西。
看看他怎么做，再请他讲讲这些溶液的制作方法就行。
明白了？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Well then, see you later.
You'd better get going as
soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
那就回头见。
赶紧出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
...
......

[Van Helmont]
...
......

[Van Helmont]
So if I recalibrate the combustion rate of this compound, that should negate any cohesive tendencies in this particle flux...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
那么，只要重新校准这种化合物的燃烧率，就能消除这股粒子流的凝聚倾向...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
But what am I going to do
about all of this spontaneous
crystallization?! I can't very well remove this matrix, I need it for the catalyst to reach the triple point.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
可这些自发结晶该怎么办？！
这基质又不能去掉，还得靠它让催化剂达到三相点。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Damn!
What am
I going to do?!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
该死！
我该怎么办？！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Did I use them all at a time like this?! I wonder if Nicholas has any left. Ugh, what a pain. Wait. Wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
偏偏这时候全用光了？！
不知道尼古拉那里还有没有。
啧，真麻烦。
等等。
等一下...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
...
......
Who are you?
I want to become an Alchemist?
scripts.translation: 我想成为炼金术士？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Hmm...?
What, did you just want to watch? Fine, fine, but do it quietly and leave right when you're done.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
嗯...？
怎么，只是想看看？
好，好，不过要安静，看完就走。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Stay out of my way and don't go around touching stuff. There might be some volatile materials, so it'd be dangerous to have any accidents.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
别挡路，也别乱碰东西。
这里可能有些不稳定的材料，万一出事故会很危险。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Ah, of course. The Merchant from before. So what did you learn from Molgenstein? I didn't just send you there for fun, you know.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
啊，对，是之前那个商人。
在莫尔根斯坦那里学到什么了？
我可不是让你去玩的。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Let me ask you
some questions to
check what you've
learned.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
我问几个问题，看看你学得怎么样。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Which item is not
necessary to make
a Counteragent?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
制作中和剂不需要哪种物品？

scripts.text: Karvodailnirol
scripts.translation: 卡勒波迪药水

scripts.text: Detrimindexta
scripts.translation: 帝特立米药水

scripts.text: Alcohol
scripts.translation: 酒精

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What item is not
necessary to make
a Mixture?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
制作混合剂不需要哪种物品？

scripts.text: Karvodailnirol
scripts.translation: 卡勒波迪药水

scripts.text: Detrimindexta
scripts.translation: 帝特立米药水

scripts.text: Alcohol
scripts.translation: 酒精

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Weren't you listening to Molgenstein at all? Maybe you
have to watch him make it again.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你根本没听莫尔根斯坦讲，是吧？
看来得再看他做一遍了。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
If you can't tell the exact items that you need in an experiment,
you might end up hurting yourself!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
连实验需要哪些材料都弄不清，可能会伤到自己！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Good, you've learned well.
Okay, now you know something about experimentation. You're done here, so now I can continue with my experiments.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
不错，学得挺好。
现在你对实验也有所了解了。
这里的训练结束了，我终于可以继续做实验了。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Go out and find the room next
to this one and talk to Nicholas. He'll continue your training.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
出去找隔壁的尼古拉，他会接着指导你。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What are you
still doing here?
Go! We both have
more important
things to do!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
怎么还在这里？
快走！
我们都有更重要的事要做！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What item do
you need to make
a Counteragent?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
制作中和剂需要哪种物品？

scripts.text: Feather
scripts.translation: 羽毛

scripts.text: Sticky Mucus
scripts.translation: 粘稠液体

scripts.text: Animal Gore
scripts.translation: 家畜血

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What item do
you need to make
a Mixture?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
制作混合剂需要哪种物品？

scripts.text: Monster Feed
scripts.translation: 魔物饲料

scripts.text: Ancient Lips
scripts.translation: 人鱼嘴巴

scripts.text: Rotten Bandage
scripts.translation: 腐烂绷带

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Be honest. You don't know, do you?! Didn't I say to go to Molgenstein and have him teach you?!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
说实话，你根本不知道，对吧？！
我不是让你去找莫尔根斯坦学习了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Don't even think about coming back until you talk to him! Now stop bothering me and get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
没跟他谈过，就别想回来！
别再烦我，出去！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
I need to continue my research,
and you need to finish becoming an Alchemist. Come on, get moving!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
我得继续研究，你也得完成转职炼金术士的训练。
快点行动！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Why...?!
Why, another failure?!
My calculations were
all correct! Wait...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
为什么...？！
怎么又失败了？！
我的计算明明都没错！
等等...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Perhaps, if I capacitated the thermal flux by using the neutronic gradient, it just might work...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
也许利用中子梯度来增强热流，就能成功...

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
You have transcended...
Excellent, excellent.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
你已经转生了...
很好，很好。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Welcome!
So how is your
research coming along?
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
欢迎！
你的研究进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Hm...
A Novice?
You shouldn't be
playing in a place
like this.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
嗯...
初心者？
你不该在这种地方玩耍。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Hmm...?
What's an adventurer
doing here in the
Alchemist Union?
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
嗯...？
冒险者来炼金术士工会做什么？

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Hmm...?
A Merchant?
Are you interested
in learning Alchemy?
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
嗯...？
商人？
你想学炼金术吗？

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Hmm...you don't seem to be qualified yet.
Remember, you must reach at least job level 40 to become an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
嗯...你似乎还没达到要求。
记住，至少要达到职业等级40，才能成为炼金术士。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Ah, you're almost
ready to become an
Alchemist, but you must
first allocate your unused
Skill Points.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
啊，你马上就能成为炼金术士了，不过得先把剩余的技能点全部分配完。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Ah, well done.
I can see that you
have learned all of
the basics of Alchemy.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
啊，做得好。
看来你已经掌握了炼金术的全部基础知识。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Ah...
I believe you've
already registered
for training to become
an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
啊...
我记得你已经报名参加炼金术士的训练了。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
You don't belong here.
Go and explore the wide world, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
你不属于这里。
去探索广阔的世界吧，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
At times you get results that are unexpected from an experiment. Although these may be setbacks in your research, such results can also lead to new discoveries.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
实验有时会得出意料之外的结果。
这或许会让研究受挫，却也可能带来新的发现。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
If you discover something new,
come and tell us. Don't forget that we are all working together to unlock the mysteries of science!
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
如果有新发现，记得来告诉我们。
别忘了，我们都在共同努力，揭开科学的奥秘！

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
There are a lot of volatile chemicals and dangerous
materials in this building. It'd be a lot better if you just played outside.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
这栋楼里有许多不稳定的化学品和危险材料。
你还是去外面玩比较好。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
I'm afraid there's
not much we can offer
you here if you're not
a member of our Union.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
如果不是工会成员，恐怕我们也帮不上你太多忙。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
This is the Alchemist Union.
We research and experiment with many different substances in order to create new materials without using magic.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
这里是炼金术士工会。
我们研究各种物质，开展实验，希望不用魔法也能创造出新材料。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Someday, we hope to unlock
the secret of life, as well as the other mysteries of science.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
希望有一天，我们能解开生命的秘密，以及科学的其他奥秘。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
After being traveling as a Merchant for a long time, you must have developed some scientific curiosity. If you'd like to learn Alchemy, why don't you try joining the Alchemist Union?
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
你当商人四处旅行这么久，一定也对科学产生了好奇吧。
如果想学炼金术，不妨加入炼金术士工会？

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Talk to me again
once you have spent
all of your extra
Skill Points.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
把剩余的技能点都用完，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Henceforth, you are
now a member of our
illustrious Union.
I hope you learn a lot...
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
从今以后，你就是我们这个享有盛誉的工会的一员了。
希望你能学有所成...

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Let me give you
something special.
You can use this to
begin your life
of research.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
我送你一份特别的礼物。
用它开启你的研究生涯吧。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
And...
Here's a little
something to help
you begin your
research.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
还有...
这点东西能帮你开始研究。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
I'll see
you later then...
Remember to carry
yourself with pride
as an Alchemist!
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
那么，回头见...
记住，身为炼金术士，要时刻保持自豪！

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Please listen to the
other Alchemists and follow their instructions carefully. You will learn much from them.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
认真听其他炼金术士讲解，仔细按照他们的指导去做。
你会从他们那里学到很多。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you are carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back again -
- after you store some items into kafra storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 您携带的物品太多了。 -
- 请先将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库，再回来。 -

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Ooh...
You're the upstart
Merchant that wants
to become an Alchemist?
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
Ooh...
你就是那个想成为炼金术士的新晋商人？

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Not just anyone can become an Alchemist, you know. You've got to have motivation and clear goals and a strong sense of focus.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
不是谁都能当炼金术士的。
你得有动力，有明确的目标，还要足够专注。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Alchemists must memorize many chemical equations, scientific laws and a lot of other information. It's actually pretty tough.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
炼金术士要记住许多化学方程式、科学定律和其他知识。
这可不容易。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
If you can't focus, you'll be confused later when you look at Alchemy charts. My test will judge your ability to do just that.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
如果不能集中注意力，以后看炼金术图表时，就会一头雾水。
我的测试就是要检验你的专注力。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Find the words scrambled
in the group of letters I give you. They can be made by using some
or all of the letters.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
从我给出的字母组里，找出能用这些字母拼成的单词。
可以用其中一部分，也可以全部用上。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
You pass if you
choose the word
that is ^551A8BIN^000000 the puzzle.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
选出^551A8B能用题目中的字母拼成^000000的单词，就算通过。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Ah, you finished.
Now, let's see...
Excellent job!
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
啊，答完了。
让我看看...
做得很好！

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Ah, you finished.
Now, let's see...
^666666*Gasp!*^000000 H-horrible!
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
啊，答完了。
让我看看...
^666666*Gasp!*^000000 太、太糟糕了！

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Great, you found all of those hidden words. With that kind of concentration, you should have no problem memorizing information.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
很好，所有隐藏的单词都找到了。
有这样的专注力，记忆知识应该不成问题。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Come back in a little bit while
I prepare the next assignment
for your training.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
稍后再来吧，我先准备下一个训练任务。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Oh, and before you talk to
me again, make sure you have
^551A8Bplenty of room in your inventory^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
哦，对了，再来找我之前，记得确保^551A8B物品栏有足够的空位^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Judging from these results, you obviously have a problem with concentrating.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
从结果来看，你显然不够专注。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
If you can't even solve these easy word puzzles, how can you keep track of your experiments and research?
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
连这么简单的字母题都解不出来，以后怎么理清实验和研究中的各种细节？

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Why don't you relax
and rest a bit before
you take the test again?
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
先放松一下，休息会儿再来考试吧？

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Whoa...
You're carrying too much stuff! First, put some of your things in Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
Whoa...
你带的东西太多了！
先把一些物品存进卡普拉仓库吧。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Alright...
For your next
assignment, you'll
need to travel to ^551A8BJuno^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
好...
下一个任务，需要你前往^551A8B朱诺^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
There, you'll need to talk to ^551A8BBain^000000 and ^551A8BBajin^000000. Those two are doing Alchemy research with the Sages
in Juno. You'll learn something by assisting them with their project.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
到那里找^551A8B贝恩^000000和^551A8B巴金^000000。
他们正在和朱诺的贤者一起研究炼金术。
协助他们的研究，你也能学到一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Come back here to me after you
help them out. They'll need all of these items to continue their experiments.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
帮完他们后，再回来找我。
他们需要这些物品来继续实验。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
1 Mixture,
5 Burnt Tree,
5 Fine Sand,
3 Rough Oridecon
and 3 Rough Elunium.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
1瓶混合剂、
5块燃烧一半的木材、
5份黄晶沙、
3个神之金属原石和
3个铝原石。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Alright.
Have a safe trip
and come back in
one piece.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
好。
一路平安，记得平安回来。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Didn't I say to
go to Juno and help
Bain and Bajin with
their Alchemy research?
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
我不是叫你去朱诺，帮贝恩和巴金研究炼金术吗？

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Ah, you're back!
I just got a message from Bain
and Bajin. They let me know that they were very happy with your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
啊，你回来了！
我刚收到贝恩和巴金的消息。
他们说你的帮助让他们非常满意。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
If you were good enough
to help out those brothers,
you definitely qualify to be
an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
能帮上那兄弟俩的忙，就说明你完全有资格成为炼金术士。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Good work!
All you have to do now is speak to the Union Leader on the 2nd floor! Congratulations, you'll become an Alchemist very soon!
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
做得好！
现在只要去二楼找会长谈谈就行了！
恭喜，你很快就能成为炼金术士了！

scripts.text:

现在只要去二楼找会长谈谈就行了！
恭喜，你很快就能成为炼金术士了！
